components.name: accordion
components.summary: Vertically stacked sections that expand and collapse to reveal content.
components.hintWhenMissing: Collapsed panels hide their content; an accordion is found by its triggers (aria-expanded). Pass a page with a section opened to see the open state.

components.name: alert
components.summary: Callout that draws attention to a message with an icon, title and description.
components.hintWhenMissing: Alerts only appear in response to a condition (error, notice). A page showing the message would reveal it.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.summary: Modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only exists while open: pass a page that shows it open or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: aspect-ratio
components.summary: Container that keeps its content at a fixed width-to-height ratio.
components.hintWhenMissing: No visual of its own; it is a sizing wrapper. Detected only through the data-slot or a padding-bottom ratio box.

components.name: attachment
components.summary: File or media chip in a chat composer or message, with upload state and actions.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only in AI/chat UIs with attached files. A page showing a composer with an attachment would reveal it.

components.name: avatar
components.summary: Image of a user with a text fallback.
components.hintWhenMissing: Avatars show up where people are listed (comments, headers, menus). Pages without user content have none.

components.name: badge
components.summary: Small label for status, count or category.
components.hintWhenMissing: Badges appear next to titles, counts or statuses; pages without such metadata have none.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.summary: Trail showing the path to the current page.
components.hintWhenMissing: Breadcrumbs appear only on pages nested inside a hierarchy (docs, detail pages), not on top-level pages.

components.name: bubble
components.summary: Chat message bubble with optional reactions.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only in chat/AI interfaces. A page showing a conversation would reveal it.

components.name: button
components.summary: Clickable control that triggers an action.
components.hintWhenMissing: Almost every page has buttons; if none are found the page may use only links or custom elements without a button role.

components.name: button-group
components.summary: Group of related buttons joined into one control.
components.hintWhenMissing: Grouped buttons are used in toolbars and segmented actions; pages with only lone buttons have none.

components.name: calendar
components.summary: Month grid for picking a date or a range.
components.hintWhenMissing: Calendars usually live inside a date-picker popover and exist only when it is open; pass a page showing it open or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: card
components.summary: Contained surface that groups related content with header, body and footer.
components.hintWhenMissing: Cards are recognised by their surface (border, radius, padding); pages built from plain sections may have none.

components.name: carousel
components.summary: Slideshow of items navigable with previous/next controls.
components.hintWhenMissing: Carousels are uncommon outside marketing pages; JS libraries that use other markup need a hint class like "carousel".

components.name: chart
components.summary: Recharts-based chart with themed tooltip and legend.
components.hintWhenMissing: Charts are rendered into SVG/canvas by a chart library; only dashboards have them, and the data may load after the first paint.

components.name: checkbox
components.summary: Control that toggles a value on or off, with an optional mixed state.
components.hintWhenMissing: Checkboxes appear in forms, filters and tables; native inputs without an aria-checked attribute match by input type.

components.name: code-block
components.summary: Syntax-highlighted code with a copy button.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only in docs or AI chat output; plain <pre> blocks are matched, other renderers are not.

components.name: collapsible
components.summary: Panel that expands and collapses a region of content.
components.hintWhenMissing: Collapsed content is hidden; pass a page with the section expanded to see the open state.

components.name: combobox
components.summary: Autocomplete input with a filterable list of options.
components.hintWhenMissing: The input is visible, but its option list exists only while open: pass a page showing it open or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: command
components.summary: Command palette: searchable list of actions and items.
components.hintWhenMissing: Command palettes usually open with a keyboard shortcut; pass a page showing it open or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: context-menu
components.summary: Menu shown on right click.
components.hintWhenMissing: Menu content is only in the DOM while open: pass a page that shows the menu open or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: data-table
components.summary: Table with sorting, filtering, pagination and row selection (TanStack Table recipe).
components.hintWhenMissing: A recipe, not a single component: found as a table with sort/filter/pagination controls nearby. Pages without lists of records have none.

components.name: date-picker
components.summary: Input with a calendar popover for picking a date.
components.hintWhenMissing: A recipe (button + popover + calendar); the calendar exists only while open: pass a page showing it open or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: dialog
components.summary: Modal window overlaid on the page.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only exists while open: pass a page that shows it open or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: direction
components.summary: Provider that sets text direction (LTR/RTL) for components.
components.hintWhenMissing: Renders nothing; it only sets the dir attribute, so it has no visual to find.

components.name: drawer
components.summary: Panel that slides in from a screen edge, draggable on touch.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only exists while open: pass a page that shows it open or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.summary: Menu opened from a trigger button.
components.hintWhenMissing: Menu content is only in the DOM while open: pass a page that shows the menu open or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: empty
components.summary: Placeholder shown when there is no content or data.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only shown for empty lists, searches or first-run states; a page with data has none.

components.name: field
components.summary: Form field layout: label, control, description and error.
components.hintWhenMissing: Fields are recognised from the label + control + help-text layout; pages without forms have none.

components.name: form
components.summary: Form wrapper with labels, controls, descriptions and validation messages (react-hook-form).
components.hintWhenMissing: Wrapper only; the visual parts are its labels, controls and messages. Validation messages appear only after a failed submit.

components.name: hover-card
components.summary: Preview card shown when hovering a link or element.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only exists while hovered: crawl with --reveal or pass a page that shows it open.

components.name: input
components.summary: Single-line text field.
components.hintWhenMissing: Text inputs exist on pages with forms or search; none found means the page has no text fields.

components.name: input-group
components.summary: Input joined with icons, text or buttons as addons.
components.hintWhenMissing: Seen on search boxes and inputs with prefixes/suffixes; plain inputs have none.

components.name: input-otp
components.summary: One-time-code input split into individual slots.
components.hintWhenMissing: Appears only on verification screens (login, 2FA).

components.name: item
components.summary: Flexible row for lists: media, title, description and actions.
components.hintWhenMissing: List-like rows are common but generic; they are recognised only by their data-slot or a structural match.

components.name: kbd
components.summary: Keyboard key hint.
components.hintWhenMissing: Shown next to shortcuts and in docs; pages without keyboard hints have none.

components.name: label
components.summary: Text label associated with a form control.
components.hintWhenMissing: Labels belong to form controls; pages without forms have none.

components.name: marker
components.summary: Divider or annotation line inside a chat conversation (e.g. a date or event).
components.hintWhenMissing: Only in chat/AI interfaces.

components.name: menubar
components.summary: Horizontal application menu bar with dropdown menus.
components.hintWhenMissing: The bar is visible on desktop-app style pages; its menus only exist while open (use --reveal).

components.name: message
components.summary: Chat message with avatar, header, content and footer.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only in chat/AI interfaces.

components.name: message-scroller
components.summary: Scrollable chat transcript that sticks to the latest message.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only in chat/AI interfaces.

components.name: native-select
components.summary: Styled native <select> element.
components.hintWhenMissing: Native selects appear only in forms; the open list is drawn by the browser and cannot be inspected.

components.name: navigation-menu
components.summary: Site navigation bar with flyout content panels.
components.hintWhenMissing: The nav bar is nearly always present; flyout panels only exist while a trigger is open (use --reveal).

components.name: pagination
components.summary: Page navigation with previous/next and numbered links.
components.hintWhenMissing: Pagination appears only on long lists or tables; pages with all content on one screen have none.

components.name: popover
components.summary: Floating panel anchored to a trigger.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only exists while open: pass a page that shows it open or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: progress
components.summary: Bar showing completion of a task.
components.hintWhenMissing: Progress bars only exist during loading or multi-step tasks.

components.name: questionnaire
components.summary: Multi-step question card asking the user to choose answers.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only in AI/agent interfaces that ask clarifying questions.

components.name: radio-group
components.summary: Set of radio buttons where only one can be chosen.
components.hintWhenMissing: Radio groups appear in forms and settings; pages without choices have none.

components.name: resizable
components.summary: Panels separated by draggable handles.
components.hintWhenMissing: Rare outside app-style layouts (editors, dashboards).

components.name: scroll-area
components.summary: Scrollable region with custom scrollbars.
components.hintWhenMissing: Custom scrollbars show only when content overflows; native scrolling leaves no marker.

components.name: select
components.summary: Dropdown for choosing one option from a list.
components.hintWhenMissing: The trigger is visible, but the option list only exists while open: pass a page showing it open or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: separator
components.summary: Visual divider between content.
components.hintWhenMissing: Dividers are often drawn as borders on neighbouring elements, which leaves no separator element.

components.name: sheet
components.summary: Panel that slides in from a screen edge.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only exists while open: pass a page that shows it open or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: sidebar
components.summary: Collapsible application sidebar with groups and menu items.
components.hintWhenMissing: Sidebars are used by app/docs layouts; on mobile it becomes a sheet that exists only when open.

components.name: skeleton
components.summary: Placeholder shaped like content while it loads.
components.hintWhenMissing: Skeletons only exist while data loads; crawl early or throttle the network to see them.

components.name: slider
components.summary: Draggable control for picking a value or range.
components.hintWhenMissing: Sliders appear in settings, filters and media players; pages without numeric ranges have none.

components.name: sonner
components.summary: Toast notifications (Sonner).
components.hintWhenMissing: Toasts appear only after an action and vanish; trigger one with a pass-through page or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: spinner
components.summary: Rotating indicator for loading.
components.hintWhenMissing: Spinners exist only while something loads.

components.name: switch
components.summary: Toggle control for turning a setting on or off.
components.hintWhenMissing: Switches appear in settings and forms; pages without preferences have none.

components.name: table
components.summary: Semantic table of rows and columns.
components.hintWhenMissing: Pages without tabular data have none; div-based grids without table roles are not matched.

components.name: tabs
components.summary: Tabbed views where one panel shows at a time.
components.hintWhenMissing: Tabs appear where content is split into views; hidden tab panels are not visible, so only the active one can be measured.

components.name: textarea
components.summary: Multi-line text field.
components.hintWhenMissing: Textareas appear in forms, comment boxes and chat composers.

components.name: toast
components.summary: Notification that appears briefly after an action (Base UI toast).
components.hintWhenMissing: Toasts appear only after an action and vanish; trigger one or crawl with --reveal.

components.name: toggle
components.summary: Two-state button that can be pressed on or off.
components.hintWhenMissing: Toggles appear in toolbars and editors; pages without formatting controls have none.

components.name: toggle-group
components.summary: Set of toggle buttons where one or several can be on.
components.hintWhenMissing: Used in toolbars and view switchers; pages without such controls have none.

components.name: tooltip
components.summary: Small hint shown on hover or focus.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only exists while hovered or focused: crawl with --reveal or pass a page that shows one.

components.name: trace
components.summary: Collapsible record of an AI agent's steps or tool calls.
components.hintWhenMissing: Only in AI/agent interfaces that show reasoning or tool traces.

components.name: typography
components.summary: Styles for headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes and inline code.
components.hintWhenMissing: Not a component; it is a set of text styles. If no headings or prose are found the page has no text content.
